episodes.logline: Mara sets a trap in the dark lamp room as a ship drifts toward the reef.

events.text: Wide shot of the lamp room as the great lens turns slowly.
Mara wipes salt spray from the glass with a rag.
Thunder rolls across the bay.
Close-up on Mara, exhausted, rain streaking the window behind her.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "Third storm this week. The lens won't last the winter."
Insert on the desk radio as its dial light flickers.
Static, then a faint voice breaking through.

events.speaker: VOICE ON RADIO
events.text: "Harbor Light, do you read? A boat is coming in without lights."
Mara snatches up the radio handset.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "Who is this? Identify your vessel."

events.speaker: VOICE ON RADIO
events.text: "Tell Mara her brother is on board."
Extreme close-up on Mara's face, frozen.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "Elias has been dead for six years."
Tracking shot as Mara runs down the spiral stairs.
Her lantern swings wildly against the stone walls.
A heavy knock on the iron door below.
Low angle on the door as rainwater pours beneath it.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "Who's there?"

events.speaker: ELIAS
events.text: "You kept the light burning. I knew you would."
Mara slides the bolt back with shaking hands.
The door swings open on a soaked man holding a sealed envelope.

events.speaker: ELIAS
events.text: "This was never meant for you. But you have to read it before dawn."
Close-up on the wax seal, pressed with the harbor master's crest.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "That's Captain Rhee's seal."
Mara and Elias on the gallery as the storm begins to ease.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "Where have you been all this time?"

events.speaker: ELIAS
events.text: "On the boats Rhee said were lost."
Elias rolls up his sleeve to show a rope-burn scar.
Close-up on the scar, pale against his wet skin.

events.speaker: ELIAS
events.text: "He keeps the crews quiet. One way or another."
A distant engine coughs out on the water.
Mara turns toward the dark bay.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "Someone's out there right now. With no lights."
Elias drips by the stove while Mara keeps the table between them.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "Six years. Not one word."

events.speaker: ELIAS
events.text: "Rhee told everyone I drowned. It kept me alive."
Mara breaks the wax seal with her thumb.
Paper tears.
Insert on the letter: a column of ship names and dates.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "These are the boats lost on the reef."

events.speaker: ELIAS
events.text: "They weren't lost. They were steered there."
Mara looks up at the lens turning in the dark above them.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "Someone dimmed the light on those nights."
Wide shot of the empty pier in grey morning light.
Captain Rhee walks the boards with his collar turned up.

events.speaker: RHEE
events.text: "Mara. You look like you haven't slept."

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "The radio kept me up. A boat came in without lights."
Close-up on Rhee's hand tightening around his cane.

events.speaker: RHEE
events.text: "No boat came in last night. I'd have known."
Mara steps back toward the lighthouse path.

events.speaker: RHEE
events.text: "Whatever you found, burn it. For Elias's sake."
Extreme close-up on Mara as the gulls go quiet.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "How do you know about Elias?"
Rhee's office, sea charts pinned to every wall.
Mara slips through the unlocked door and closes it softly.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "A chart for every night a boat went down."
Insert on a chart: the reef circled in red ink.
Footsteps climb the wooden stairs outside.
Mara folds the chart into her coat.
The brass door handle begins to turn.

events.speaker: RHEE
events.text: "Who's in my office?"
Mara presses herself flat behind the door.
Mara and Elias spread the letter beside the lamp controls.

events.speaker: ELIAS
events.text: "He'll come tonight. He still has a key to this room."
Mara wires a small brass bell to the trapdoor hinge.
Wind howls through the iron gallery.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "Then we let him think the light is his."
The lens slows as Mara pulls the main power lever.
The motor winds down into silence.
Darkness. Only Elias's lantern glows.

events.speaker: ELIAS
events.text: "If a boat is out there, we just blinded it."

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "Two minutes. That's all we need."
The trapdoor bell rings once.
Low angle as a figure climbs the stairs behind a lantern.

events.speaker: RHEE
events.text: "Mara? The light's gone out. Let me help."
Mara steps into the lantern light, holding the letter.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "Help the way you helped the Seabird? And the Northern Star?"
Rhee's face hardens.

events.speaker: RHEE
events.text: "Give me the letter."
Elias steps out of the shadows behind him.

events.speaker: ELIAS
events.text: "Hello, Captain."
Extreme close-up on Rhee as the lens flickers back to life.
A ship's horn blares close to the rocks.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "That's a boat. Right on the reef."
A fishing boat drifts toward the rocks, its deck lamps dark.
Waves crash against the hull.
The lighthouse beam sweeps back across the water.
The crew scramble to haul the wheel around.

events.speaker: CREW MEMBER
events.text: "Hard to port! The light's back!"
Wide shot as the boat slides past the reef with a metre to spare.

events.speaker: ELIAS
events.text: "We made it."
Mara watches from the gallery, the letter still in her hand.

events.speaker: MARA
events.text: "Not all of them. Not yet."
